description: NASA’s James Webb Space Telescope has revealed early galaxies that appear almost as old as the universe itself. By analyzing 31 galaxies at high redshift, researchers estimated stellar ages of around 600 million years—close to the universe’s age at that epoch. One galaxy may even seem older than the universe, posing a potential challenge to the standard Lambda-CDM cosmological model if confirmed.
title: James Webb Telescope Finds Galaxies Nearly as Old as the Early Universe

description: Android 17 Beta 1 update will roll out soon to Pixel devices who are enrolled in the company’s Beta Programme, the Android Beta team announced on Wednesday via a Reddit post. This comes shortly after the company began rolling out the Android 16 Quarterly Platform Release 3 (QPR3) Beta 2.1 update to devices, allowing them to provide feedback and report bugs before it is released to a wider user base. However, the company has yet to reveal Android 17’s user interface changes, features, compatible devices, and the exact release timeline.
title: Android 17 Beta 1 Expected to Roll Out to Eligible Pixel Devices Soon: Expected UI Changes, Features

description: Microsoft has highlighted several risks with artificial intelligence (AI) agents in its latest security report. The most interesting insight is about “AI double agents,” which are basically agents with excessive privileges but not enough safeguards. This makes them vulnerable to prompt engineering attacks by bad actors, and turns them into “double agents.”
title: Microsoft Warns AI Tools With Excessive Privileges Could Act as ‘Double Agents’

description: Sony will unveil the WF-1000XM6 on February 12, and new leaks have revealed more design details ahead of launch. Comparison images shared by The Walkman Blog suggest the earbuds are thicker than the WF-1000XM4 and taller than the WF-1000XM5, meaning they may protrude more. The WF-1000XM6 is expected to feature a faster QN3e chip, eight microphones, upgraded audio hardware, smarter ANC modes, and new connectivity features.
title: Sony WF‑1000XM6 Leak Reveals Size Differences With WF‑1000XM5 and WF‑1000XM4

description: NASA’s SPHEREx telescope captured a dramatic outburst from interstellar comet 3I/ATLAS after its close solar flyby in October 2025. Infrared observations in December revealed water vapor, carbon dioxide, methanol, methane, and cyanide erupting from the comet’s nucleus. Scientists say the chemical makeup suggests formation in a relatively warm environment beyond our solar system. The rare detection provides valuable insight into the composition and thermal history of material formed around another distant star system.
title: SPHEREx Captures Dramatic Outburst of Interstellar Comet 3I/ATLAS

description: This list highlights some of the best gaming headphones in India across budgets, including the HyperX Cloud II, Razer BlackShark V2 X, JBL Quantum 100M2, Kreo Beluga V2, and EvoFox Hyperion. Options range from premium models with virtual 7.1 surround sound and durable builds to affordable headsets with solid drivers and clear microphones. Features include memory foam comfort, detachable or flip-mute mics, multi-platform support, and wired connectivity.
title: Best Gaming Headphones in India: HyperX Cloud II, Razer BlackShark V2 X, and More

description: Google-owned Mandiant Cybersecurity Consulting firm has published a report detailing the modus operandi of the North Korea-based UNC1069 threat actors, who specifically target entities in the cryptocurrency and decentralised finance industry. The hackers take out ClickFix scams using social engineering tactics. A victim is first contacted via Telegram, where they are sent a link to a fake Zoom meeting. After joining the meeting, the hackers play AI-generated deep fake videos of known personalities to gain their trust, in turn infecting their systems with malware families.
title: Hackers Use ClickFix Scam to Target Crypto Executive via Fake Zoom Meetings

description: Lumio on Wednesday announced the rollout of the Android 14 update across its entire Lumio Vision TV lineup, with the Lumio Arc projector set to follow soon. With this move, the Bengaluru-based brand claims to be the first to deliver a portfolio-wide Android 14 update spanning its smart TVs, along with its projector range. As per the company, the update is aimed at improving performance, stability, and overall user experience while retaining the familiar Google TV interface that customers are already accustomed to.
title: Lumio Vision TVs to Receive Android 14 Update With Performance Improvements; Arc Projector to Follow

description: Maruva Tarama, starring Hariish Dhanunjaya, Athulya Chandra, and Avantika Hari Nalwa, premieres on ETV Win this Valentine’s Day. Directed by Chaitanya Varma Nadimpalli, the romantic musical drama tells a touching story of love and sacrifice, earning a strong 9.2/10 on IMDb.
title: Maruva Tarama OTT Release Date: When and Where to Watch it Online?

description: Amazon's Echo Show 11 features a new design with a Full-HD display. It is available in India at Rs. 26,999, but should you buy? Read to find out.
title: Amazon Echo Show 11 Review: A Much-Needed Refresh

Directed by Maari and starring Naveen Polishetty and Meenakshi Chaudhary, the film mixes rural politics, romance, and satire in a vibrant festival setting. Its humorous storytelling and strong cast performances helped it resonate with a wide audience.
title: Anaganaga Oka Raju Now Streaming on OTT: What You Need to Know About This Telugu Comedy Movie

description: WhatsApp allows users to back up and restore chats.  This guide offers step-by-step methods for both Android and iOS users to back up chat history. Before starting, make sure you have an active internet connection and enough storage on your devices. Users can also set up recurring backups on their Android and iOS smartphones. Users cannot back up or restore chats from linked devices like WhatsApp for Web.
title: How to Restore WhatsApp Chats on Android and iPhone: A Step-by-Step Guide

description: Instagram might soon release a feature that allows it to compete with OpenAI’s Sora app. As per a tipster, the Meta-owned platform is working on a face swap feature that allows users to submit their own likeness and generate images and videos using AI. Additionally, it is said that users will be able to request the likeness of other users as well.
title: Instagram Said to Be Working On AI-Powered Face Swap Feature, Takes On OpenAI’s Sora

description: The Maadhar is a recently released Tamil Short Thriller Film which explores the theme of crime and eerie punishments as a grieving father hunts down the killers of his daughter. The sequences of the film are gripping and dark.
title: The Maadhar Streaming Now on OTTPlus: Know Everything About This Tamil Short Thriller Film

description: Google on Wednesday announced an update to its Search reporting tools that aims to make it easier for individuals to request the removal of non-consensual explicit images from search results. As per the Mountain View-based tech giant, the revamped system is designed to simplify the reporting experience, offer clearer guidance, and improve transparency around the process of removal requests.
title: Google Updates Search Tools to Simplify Removal of Non-Consensual Explicit Images

description: Konami is finally ready to share an update on Silent Hill: Townfall, the upcoming survival-horror game from Screen Burn. The publisher has announced the next Silent Hill Transmission broadcast. The presentation will be livestreamed on February 12 and will feature the latest update on Silent Hill: Townfall.
title: Konami Announces Silent Hill Transmission Broadcast for This Week, Will Share Update on Silent Hill: Townfall

description: Nothing Phone 4a Pro has reportedly appeared on the UAE’s TDRA certification database, adding to signs that the Phone 4a series launch may be near. The model number A069 was previously linked to the Pro variant and was also spotted on Europe’s EEC platform. Leaks suggest the Phone 4a lineup could debut globally in early March with UFS 3.1 storage, Snapdragon chips, new colours, and eSIM support. Prices may rise due to higher RAM and component costs.
title: Nothing Phone 4a Pro Inches Closer to Launch as Smartphone Surfaces on UAE's TDRA Certification Database

description: Two dedicated microsites for Samsung’s Galaxy Unpacked event are now live on Amazon and Flipkart. The event, which is scheduled to take place on February 25 at 1 pm ET (11:30 pm IST) in San Francisco, California, is expected to feature the launch of the purported Samsung Galaxy S26, Galaxy S26+, Galaxy S26 Ultra, Galaxy Buds 4, and Galaxy 4 Pro. The new microsites on Amazon and Flipkart confirm that the upcoming smartphones and TWS will go on sale in the country via the two e-commerce platforms.
title: Samsung Galaxy S26 Series, Galaxy Buds 4 Lineup to Be Available in India via Amazon, Flipkart

description: Airtel has unveiled a new Fraud Alert system to warn users about potential bank-related one-time passwords (OTP) scams, the telecom service provider (TSP) announced. The system will leverage AI to detect potentially risky incoming calls after an OTP has been received. The TSP will then send alerts to users, intervening and warning subscribers. This comes soon after the Supreme Court stated during a hearing that Indians have lost more than Rs. 54,000 crore to digital arrest scams, during which a bad actor coerces victims to share their banking information and OTPs.
title: Airtel Unveils AI-Powered System Designed to Warn Users About OTP-Related Bank Frauds

description: Oceanhorn 3: Legend of the Shadow Sea will be available exclusively on Apple Arcade beginning next month, the company announced on Tuesday. Developed by Cornfox & Brothers, it is the highly anticipated new chapter in the popular action-RPG-adventure franchise, set nearly a thousand years after the events of Oceanhorn 2: Knights of the Lost Realm. Apple has highlighted the title as one of the key additions to Apple Arcade’s March lineup.
title: Apple Arcade’s March Update Brings Oceanhorn 3: Legend of the Shadow Sea and Other Titles

description: EA has shared an overview of new season 2 content coming to Battlefield 6 on February 17. The military shooter will get a new map, titled Contaminated, and a new limited-time mode as season 2 kicks off next week. Season 2 will also being a host of improvements to the game's progression system.
title: Battlefield 6 Season 2 Content and Gameplay Improvements Teased Ahead of Launch

description: Select smartphones in the Infinix Note 60 line will, for the first time, be powered by Snapdragon mobile platforms. The company previously used MediaTek chipsets for its Note series smartphones. The Infinix Note 60 Pro is already teased to come with the Snapdragon 7s Gen 4 5G chipset. It will launch in Nigeria soon in three colour options. The Note 60 Pro is confirmed to come with a 50-megapixel rear camera and a 6,500mAh battery with 90W charging support.
title: Infinix Will Equip Select Note 60 Series Models With Snapdragon Chips for the First Time

description: Motorola Edge 70 Fusion renders have leaked again, matching earlier reports and revealing a slim phone with curved edges, a textured rear panel, and a triple-camera module. The leaked images show a curved AMOLED display with narrow bezels and a centred hole-punch selfie camera. Multiple Pantone-certified colour options are expected. The handset recently appeared on Geekbench and may feature a Snapdragon 7s Gen 4 SoC, 7,000mAh battery, and IP68/IP69 durability ratings.
title: Motorola Edge 70 Fusion Design, Colourways Spotted in Leaked Renders and Marketing Images

description: Oppo Find X9 Ultra could launch soon, and recent leaks have offered some clues about several key features of the upcoming handset. Now,  alleged live images of the handset have surfaced online, showcasing its rear design. The handset is shown inside a protective case with a circular rear camera module. It appears to have a quad rear camera setup. The Oppo Find X9 Ultra is tipped to come with Hasselblad-backed cameras, a 6.8-inch display and a Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chipset.
title: Oppo Find X9 Ultra Spotted in Live Images That Offer a Sneak Peek at Its Rear Camera Layout

description: Google has sparked speculation about FaceTime support on Android after the Pixel 10a store page claimed users can “keep video chatting, even with FaceTime.” The line appears in a section aimed at iPhone switchers, ahead of Pixel 10a pre-orders opening February 18, 2026. However, it likely refers to Apple’s existing web-link system that lets Android users join FaceTime calls through a browser, not a native app. Similar wording has appeared on earlier Pixel pages.
title: Google Pixel 10a Store Page Suggests FaceTime Compatibility for iPhone Switchers: Here's What It Means

description: iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max are expected to arrive this September alongside the much-rumoured iPhone Fold. We have seen possible specifications of the new models recently through leaks. Now, a reputed analyst reportedly opined that Apple plans to keep pricing steady for its new iPhone 18 Pro models despite reports of rising memory costs. This seems to align with an earlier claim made by  TF International Securities analyst Ming-Chi Kuo.
title: iPhone 18 Pro Series Said to Launch at Last Year's Prices Despite Rising Component Costs

description: PS Plus Game Catalogue lineup for February has been leaked. According to a report, Marvel's Spider-Man 2 will be added to the game subscription service on February 17. Game Catalogue will reportedly also add racing title Test Drive Unlimited Solar Crown and puzzle platformer Neva.
title: Marvel's Spider-Man 2 Is Reportedly Coming to PS Plus Game Catalogue in February

description: The Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY) notified the amendments to the IT Rules, 2021, on Tuesday. The fresh rules focus heavily on artificial intelligence (AI)-generated content and deepfakes, bringing more flexible labelling guidelines for AI content and stricter takedown timelines for inappropriate media and deepfakes. These new sets of rules also more clearly define deepfakes and outline consequences for users who violate them.
title: MeitY Notifies Fresh IT Rules to Regulate AI-Generated Content, Deepfakes on Social Media Platforms

description: Zeiss Aatma lenses have been unveiled in India, the company announced on Tuesday. The new series includes nine lenses, with focal lengths including 18mm, 25mm, 35mm, 40mm, 50mm, 65mm, 85mm, 100mm, and 135mm. Featuring a T1.5 aperture, the full-frame prime lenses are targeted towards cinematographers and filmmakers. While customers can order the Zeiss Aatma lenses now via the company's website, the deliveries will begin in India in June via authorised Zeiss Cinema retailers.
title: Zeiss Launches Aatma Lenses in India With Retro Design, Up to 135mm Focal Length: Availability, Features

description: Google Maps could soon get a new artificial intelligence (AI) feature that will let users have conversations about locations and routes. As per the report, the Mountain View-based tech giant is working on a feature dubbed “Ask Maps,” which brings a Gemini-like chat interface to the platform. If true, this would further integrate Maps as one of the company’s AI ecosystem products, after it released hands-free voice-based AI navigation assistance for several modes.
title: Google Maps’ New Gemini Feature to Reportedly Let You Chat About Places and Routes

description: In recent weeks, reports have emerged that several smartphone brands are investing towards the development of 200-megapixel camera sensors for their future handsets. According to a seasoned tipster, a major smartphone manufacturer is testing not one, but two 200-megapixel rear cameras for use in its future flagship model. What sets the mystery handset apart is the inclusion of a 100-megapixel front-facing camera, which is believed to be an industry-first step.
title: Mysterious Flagship Phone Tipped to Feature 100-Megapixel Selfie Camera, Dual 200-Megapixel Rear Cameras

description: Nothing has begun rolling out the beta version of its Essential Apps Builder in batches to Nothing Phone 3 users, the UK-based smartphone maker announced on Tuesday via a community post. The tech firm first launched the app builder, which allows users to generate apps and widgets using natural language or vibe coding, in September 2025. Earlier, the functionality was only available to a limited number of internal and community members.
title: Nothing‘s Essential Apps Builder Now in Beta; Lets Users Vibe Code Personalised Apps

description: Scientists analysing NASA’s Magellan radar data have identified signs of a vast underground lava tunnel on Venus. If confirmed, it would be only the second such structure found on the planet, challenging the belief that Venus is geologically inactive and opening new possibilities for studying its volcanic past.
title: Venus May Hide a Vast Underground Tunnel Formed by Ancient Volcanic Eruptions, Scientists Say

description: Apple and Google have agreed to make four changes to their respective app stores to make the marketplaces fairer and more transparent to third-party developers. The announcement was made by the UK’s Competition and Markets Authority (CMA) on Tuesday after it raised questions about the company’s duopoly in the mobile application sector.
title: Apple, Google Make Four Commitments to Improve Fairness and Transparency in App Stores

description: Realme Narzo 90x 5G was launched in India in December last year in Flash Blue and Nitro Blue shades. Now, the Chinese smartphone brand has announced a new Maroon Red colour variant of the phone. It will go on sale in the country on February 14. The Realme Narzo 90x 5G runs on MediaTek Dimensity 6300 SoC and has a 7,000mAh battery. It has an IP65 dust and water resistance rating.
title: Realme Narzo 90x 5G Gets a New Valentine's Special Maroon Colour Option in India: Price, Specifications

description: The Samsung Galaxy S26 series is all set to be unveiled at the Galaxy Unpacked event later this month, comprising the Galaxy S26, Galaxy S26+, and Galaxy S26 Ultra models. The vanilla Galaxy S26 and Galaxy S26+ models are expected to feature minor upgrades in terms of battery, camera, display, and more, while the Ultra variant could get an upgrade to a custom version of the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chipset.
title: Samsung Galaxy S26 Series Pricing, Full Specifications Leaked Ahead of Galaxy Unpacked Event

description: YouTube is rolling out a new AI Playlist generator for Premium users on Android and iOS. Announced in an X post, the feature lets subscribers create personalised playlists by entering text or voice prompts based on mood, genre, or theme. Users can access it through the Library tab by tapping “New” and selecting “AI Playlist.” Google has shared limited details so far, and reactions are mixed. The rollout follows similar AI playlist tools from Spotify, Amazon Music, and Deezer.
title: YouTube Music Now Lets Premium Subscribers Create AI-Generated Playlists

description: Samsung Galaxy Unpacked 2026 will be held later this month, the company announced on Tuesday. The annual event is expected to witness the launch of the new generation Galaxy S series, ubiquitously known as the Galaxy S26 series. As per the South Korean technology conglomerate, it will have Galaxy AI features to make the day “easy and effortless”. Samsung has also started pre-reservations for the phones in India and the global markets.
title: Samsung Galaxy Unpacked Event Date Announced for New Galaxy S Series Launch; Pre-Reservations Begin

description: The Employees Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO) is on the verge of undergoing a significant digital transformation with the launch of EPFO 3.0. According to the government, this has been done to provide faster and more convenient facilities to salaried employees in India with regard to their provident fund facilities. It is part of the government’s broader push to strengthen digital public infrastructure and deliver citizen-centric services with minimal paperwork and faster turnaround times.
title: EPFO 3.0 Explained: What It Is, New UPI Withdrawal Service, Launch Timeline, and More
